text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The victor is—T.M. Opera O! Narita Top 
Road fell just short of claiming the 
chrysanthemum crown...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Naturally,
Narita Top Road was filled with 
frustration,
but she vowed to show an even 
greater hope next time. Even so,
she never lost sight of that hope.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That also served as a turning point for 
Admire Vega. Realizing that for "that 
girl's" sake, she needed to keep running 
toward the future.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka Sho drew to a bright close. 
Yet, that was only the beginning of Act 
Two— the Tenno Sho (Spring) was waiting 
for her.
